alerts.title: NH44 Jammu-Srinagar Highway remains shut after fresh landslide at Dewal, Udhampur
alerts.summary: The Jammu-Srinagar National Highway (NH44) — the only all-weather road link connecting the Kashmir Valley with the rest of India — remains closed after a landslide triggered by heavy rain blocked the carriageway at Dewal in Udhampur district. Restoration crews are working under active rockfall risk near the Dawal Bridge/Samroli area; authorities have not yet declared the stretch safe to reopen.
alerts.impact: Direct FM/LM hit: Kashmir-bound linehaul via NH44 has no alternate road route — expect multi-day TAT breaches for Srinagar, Baramulla, Anantnag hubs. Hold non-serviceable (NS) flags for Valley pincodes and pre-build buffer stock at the Jammu hub until NHAI confirms full reopening.

alerts.title: Kerala floods and landslides: 8 dead, 8 missing, over 500 rescued as heavy rain continues
alerts.summary: Heavy rainfall has caused floods and landslides across Kerala, killing at least 8 people with 8 more missing and 13 injured, per Chief Minister V. D. Satheesan. Nearly 5,800 people have been relocated to 209 relief camps, 27 houses destroyed and 196 damaged; IMD warns of further heavy to very heavy rainfall over Kerala and Mahe.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk — South zone: Expect road washouts and hub inaccessibility across Pathanamthitta and other worst-hit districts. Build temporary NS flags for affected talukas, keep contingency routing via Kochi/Kozhikode hubs, and monitor for extended TAT breaches through the week.

alerts.title: South India truckers' indefinite strike over VLTD mandate begins August 1
alerts.summary: Truck owners' associations across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Puducherry went ahead with a threatened indefinite strike from August 1, opposing mandatory Vehicle Location Tracking Devices (VLTDs) and panic buttons, plus rising toll and compliance costs. Reports on the ground-level participation and duration are still developing.
alerts.impact: Expand LM with 3P, monitor hour-by-hour: FM linehaul out of Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kochi and Coimbatore hubs is at risk. Keep 5-7 days of buffer inventory pre-positioned, line up alternate LM partners, and prepare SLA-relaxation comms for southern pincodes until the strike is confirmed resolved.

alerts.title: Kanwar Yatra 2026: Delhi route diversions live, full Delhi-Haridwar highway ban from Aug 4
alerts.summary: Delhi Traffic Police's Kanwar Yatra advisory (Jul 30 - Aug 12) is in effect: heavy vehicles are restricted/diverted on GT Road, Wazirabad Road, Vikas Marg and Loni Road, with GT Road (Apsara Border to Yamuna Bridge) fully closed Aug 9-12. Separately, all vehicle movement will be banned on the Ganga Canal road and Delhi-Haridwar Highway from August 4 to August 12.
alerts.impact: Expand LM with 3P, pre-plan now: Linehaul on Delhi-Meerut-Haridwar (NH58), Ghaziabad, and connecting UP/Uttarakhand corridors faces a total ban Aug 4-12. Shift linehaul to alternate NH-9/NH-44 corridors or night slots outside restricted windows for NCR/UP/Uttarakhand/Haryana pincodes through Aug 12.

alerts.title: Petrol/diesel steady at multi-city highs; commercial LPG cut ~₹200 from Aug 1
alerts.summary: Retail petrol and diesel prices remain unchanged since the May 25 OMC hike — Delhi ₹102.12/₹95.20 per litre (petrol/diesel), Mumbai ₹111.18/₹99.82. Separately, commercial (19kg) LPG cylinder rates were cut by roughly ₹200 effective August 1, while 14.2kg domestic cylinder rates stayed flat.
alerts.impact: Cost watch, no action yet: No immediate LM/FM disruption. Retail fuel staying flat is a mild positive for 3P per-km rate stability, but track weekly for the next OMC pricing cycle and any fresh crude volatility feeding into Delhivery/Shadowfax/Xpressbees surcharge asks.
